items.statement: Keep laboratory glassware clean, treating laboratory equipment as falling within the scope of the equipment cleaning and maintenance requirements.
items.quote: Glassware must, of course, be clean, and CGMP regulations consider laboratory equipment to be included within the scope of 21 CFR 211.67.

items.statement: Ensure residues stay within their established acceptance limits and do not adversely affect the safety, efficacy, quality or stability of the drug product.
items.quote: Residues must not exceed their established acceptance limits and must not adversely alter drug product safety, efficacy, quality, or stability (see references below).

items.statement: Use scientifically sound sampling and analytical test methods for cleaning validation that give an adequate scientific rationale supporting the validation.
items.quote: the sampling and analytical test methods should be scientifically sound and should provide adequate scientific rationale to support the validation.
